data.title: Browser Fingerprint Spoofing — User-Agent Inconsistency in Authentication Flow
data.description: Detects authentication sessions where the User-Agent string changes between sequential authentication steps — a strong indicator of AiTM proxy-based session hijacking. Bluekit advertises "full 2FA support with emulation/spoofing of geolocation and browser information," and Sneaky 2FA exhibits an "impossible device shift" where Safari/iOS is used for login but Edge/Windows for session resume. When a legitimate user authenticates, the User-Agent remains consistent throughout the flow. AiTM proxies may inject different User-Agents at different stages due to proxy architecture or deliberate fingerprint spoofing. Sourced from Bluekit PhaaS TI report and Sekoia TDR Sneaky 2FA analysis.

detection.condition: selection | group by CorrelationId | where dc(UserAgent) >= 2
detection.note: Correlate on CorrelationId (same authentication flow) rather than SessionId. A CorrelationId with 2+ distinct User-Agents within 10 minutes is abnormal — legitimate users do not change browsers mid-authentication. Strongest signal: mobile UA (Safari, Chrome-iOS) for initial login + desktop UA (Edge, Chrome-Win) for session resume. This is the Sneaky 2FA "impossible device shift" pattern. Bluekit's geolocation spoofing may also cause geographic inconsistencies between authentication steps.

queries.sentinel:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    UACount = dcount(UserAgent),
    UAs = make_set(UserAgent),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress),
    MinTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated)
  by CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName
| where UACount >= 2
| where datetime_diff('minute', MaxTime, MinTime) <= 10
| project UserPrincipalName, CorrelationId, UACount, UAs, IPs, MinTime, MaxTime
queries.cql:
#event_simpleName=UserLogon
| CorrelationId=*
| groupBy([CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName], function=[
    count(UserAgent, distinct=true, as=ua_count),
    collect([UserAgent, RemoteAddressIP4])
  ], span=10m)
| ua_count >= 2

references: Bluekit PhaaS TI Report — CrimsonVector, March 2026
Sekoia TDR Sneaky 2FA Analysis — impossible device shift pattern
Microsoft Entra ID Sign-in Logs schema documentation
falsepositives: Browser updates applied between authentication steps (rare within 10min window)
Corporate proxy rewriting User-Agent strings inconsistently
Embedded browser views (WebView) in mobile apps
